description: Plans d'alignements approuves sur voirie departementale is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by opendata.hauts-de-seine.net. Enlargement reserves or easements of alignments on departmental roads. This data provides information on the alignment plans approved by administrative decision for the benefit of the Department. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Approved alignment plans on departmental roads" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2014-03-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
